## Workload

Lena Fischer completed grading activity for 222 reads during 360 hours of rostered work. This represents an average throughput of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for the quarter and provides the basis for the review of grading capacity and output. No concerns were identified in relation to the volume of work completed. The recorded hours and activity level should be retained as part of the routine performance record.

## Quality

A sample of 15 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The results showed agreement of 66.7 per cent between the original grading and the subsequent check. This outcome is noted for routine monitoring, with no further action required this quarter. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who considered both the workload information and the checked sample. The findings have been recorded for the relevant reporting period and may be referred to in future quality reviews.
